subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose a current-session deferred `api.resetSession(reason?)` capability to after-compaction plugin hooks, with the documented lifecycle and availability limits proposed here?
rationale: This is an additive plugin-facing session-lifecycle contract, not a repair of an already documented API; code review cannot safely choose its long-term ownership and compatibility promise.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
options.body: Approve a documented after-compaction-only reset contract after the branch removes the schema shim and proves the current-head lifecycle.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Do not add the plugin hook API and instead keep any reset behavior within the owning bundled integration or compaction implementation.

options.title: Split the direction first
options.body: Move the API contract discussion into a focused proposal and keep this PR limited to any independently justified internal lifecycle repair.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Approve a documented after-compaction-only reset contract after the branch removes the schema shim and proves the current-head lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged schema policy establishes the most concrete current-main boundary implicated by this branch; their review is the best available routing signal for the required scope decision.
